name: Neill-Cochran House Museum
groundDatum: Source lidar datum; local display only, no ellipsoid placement

footprint.name: City of Austin — Building Footprints 2023
footprint.attribution: City of Austin Watershed Protection Department
footprint.selection: Reviewed against USGS/USDA aerial imagery and the public museum address; not chosen from an address-range point alone.

limitations: 2017 survey and 2023 footprint can differ from today's building.
Roof triangles interpolate classified lidar returns; small gaps and trees can affect the result.
Walls are inferred vertical surfaces. No windows, doors, siding, textures or dimensions are verified.
The ground pad is a presentation surface, not a parcel boundary or terrain model.
Visualization only. No geometry feeds renovation estimates.
